decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. Disputed posting TXN-007940 posted on 2026-07-29 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 87 days later, inside the 120-day limit (time-limits). The ledger does show a second posting of the same 53.29 EUR at the same merchant (MER-000037, BRIGHTWATER GROCERS): TXN-007939, made 2026-07-27T17:06Z and posted on 2026-07-28. However, the two postings have different authorisations, and each was approved separately. TXN-007939 used AUTH-008144: chip, PIN verified, approved. TXN-007940 used AUTH-008145: contactless, made 2026-07-28T01:06Z, about 8 hours later, approved. Neither authorisation has a fraud flag, and no refund was found at this merchant. Under duplicate-separate-authorisations, two postings with their own authorisations made some time apart are two purchases, even when the merchant and amount are the same, so the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: Our records show two separate purchases of 53.29 EUR at BRIGHTWATER GROCERS. One was made by chip and PIN on 27 July 2026 and the other by contactless payment about 8 hours later. Each payment was approved on its own, so this is not one purchase charged twice.
